QuarantineFactContent.title: QuarantineFactContent
QuarantineFactContent.description: Immutable content of one quarantine fact: tenant-scoped, subject-typed, reasoned, principal-acted, caller-instanted.

ObservabilityTenantId.title: ObservabilityTenantId
ObservabilityTenantId.description: Opaque tenant identity of the security domain: "tenant:<slug>" (the W009 grammar).

QuarantineFactKind.title: QuarantineFactKind
QuarantineFactKind.description: The quarantine fact kind: quarantine-imposed (deny-by-default) or quarantine-released (explicit, gated).

SubjectId.title: SubjectId
SubjectId.description: Opaque observation-subject identity: "<kind>:<slug>" (extension, session, simrun, action, principal, tenant, workspace, security-policy families).

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).

ObservabilityPrincipalId.title: ObservabilityPrincipalId
ObservabilityPrincipalId.description: Opaque acting principal of the security domain: "principal:<slug>" (the W009 grammar).
